🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; confirmed by very weak sector breadth (≤4/11) and both Financials and Industrials negative, supporting the RISK-OFF call. Leadership: Concentrated across Energy/Materials/Technology (3 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical favored.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%). Utilities marginally positive: sector up slightly on the week (Utilities: 10 stocks). Materials showing isolated strength via DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) but overall mixed.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag: Financials (20 stocks) down on the week with JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%) and WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%). Technology weak: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%). Consumer Discretionary and Industrials also pressured.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%). Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5: Materials/Energy/Tech).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%), TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), KHC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.13%). Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Healthcare/Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: DOW (1W: +10.04%), OXY (1W: +7.32%), LRCX (1W: +6.46%), APD (1W: +5.80%), INTC (1W: +5.41%). Note MAJOR divergence: several large-cap Tech names showing 1W up but 1M down (RECOVERY) while many staples and Financials remain BELOW TREND — watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak on the week (Technology: 24 stocks); AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%). Sector breadth is negative and short-term bounces in chips look tactical.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are pressured (Financials: 20 stocks); JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.71%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -7.34%). Weak breadth and large-cap bank underperformance reinforce RISK-OFF tone.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare weak on the week (Healthcare: 17 stocks); JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) is a defensive outlier, while TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%) and SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) show pockets of selling. Overall defensive flows limited to a few names, not broad leadership.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Materials names given above-trend leadership; reduce exposure to large-cap Financials and broad Tech names still BELOW TREND. Given MAJOR divergence among large-cap Tech (multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals), treat tech bounces as tactical and monitor for confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) — watch follow-through. BEARISH: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -11.16%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (positive on the week; several names ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Financials and Technology given continuing weakness and low overall breadth (Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA shifting from RECOVERY to ABOVE TREND on sustained 1M positive follow-through; AAPL needs a clean 1W reversal to signal tactical repair from BELOW TREND; DOW and OXY need follow-through into next week to validate materials/energy rotation; ADBE breach continuation would deepen Tech downside.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DOW (+55): DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. JNJ (+75): JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) — FDA news confirming defensive accumulation. NVDA (+55): NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) — positive headlines align with short-term bounce but 1M remains negative.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-60): ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%) — sentiment confirms price weakness. SYK (-55): SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) — bearish news confirmed by steep weekly drop. INTU (-50): INTU CORRECTION (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) — bearish headlines versus 1M strength = divergence to monitor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical favored as Energy and select Materials show leadership. XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND and DOW ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large-cap Tech (multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals) and confirming weak breadth, so monitor sentiment-driven moves closely.
